name: GPWA E-Mail Championship
epitaph: Named for Jordan Stone by the site index's own later, undated snapshot; no document in the held record shows a title match, or even names the title outright anywhere but that one ranking table.

name: GPWA Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A tournament staged across two 1998 On The Road cards (3 February, 19 March) reached its own final round -- Angry Chef against Jack Emerald -- which the held record never shows being contested; by the 5 October 1998 Topeka show Chef is billed the reigning champion, retaining the belt twice in one night against Commander Cody and then Emerald himself, still billed the #1 contender. He also defended it against Dane Thompson at an untranscribed "GPWA Slim Pickens" show, breaking Thompson's ribs. By the site index's own later, undated snapshot the belt had changed hands again, to "Sideshow" Tad Detmer -- another of the wrestlers the fed's own news names for a different, September 1998 tournament draw (the vacant ICBINR U.S. Heavyweight Championship's own 4-Corners) -- with no document in the held record showing how.
notes: The tournament final's own result (Chef over Emerald, presumably, per the bracket the 19 March 1998 card sets up) is never shown on the page; Chef's own reign is receipted from the Topeka Tabloid's "ANGRY CHEF RETAINS TITLE" headline treating the reign as already standing, not from a documented title-winning match.

name: GPWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Thunder & Lightning won a four-way match against The Cutting Edge, Ron Baxter & Hiroki Date, and the Princes of Darkness at "Small Package" (28 February 1998), then successfully defended against Date & Baxter in the held record's latest dated card result (24 May 1998). By the site index's own later, undated snapshot the belt had changed hands to The Man & The Myth, ranked in the GPWA's own tag-team rankings alongside three other pairings the held record never shows in the ring -- how or when the title changed hands is not documented.
notes: Corrected 2026-08-31: the tier-1 mint dated the title-winning match 27 April 1998, conflating the two 1998 "Small Package" cards; the held record's text places the four-way win at the 28 February 1998 Small Package, with the 27 April Small Package instead staging the match that earned Date & Baxter their own title shot.

name: ICBINR United States Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Declared vacant 28 September 1998, when the GPWA's own four entrants for a 4-Corners qualifier were announced by blind draw (Reginald Parkhurst III, Jack Emerald, Kai A. Lewis, "Sideshow" Tad Detmer) -- the qualifier's own result is not documented. Parkhurst went on to face an IOWA representative, Nate McManus, at End of the Beginning (31 December 1998), winning the inaugural reign; still champion by the held record's latest dated mention (29 March 1999) and the site index's own later snapshot alike.

name: ICBINR United States Heavyweight Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: Named "Vacant" by the site index, the held record's only mention of the title anywhere -- no reign, champion or title match survives in the held corpus.
